Engineering

Last edited: August 29, 2026  • 


Hi, my name is Haroon Amanullah. I'm a fourth-year Mechanical Engineering undergraduate at the University of Maryland, pursuing a minor in Nanoscale Science and Technology.

I want to build things that make a difference, by using engineering to tackle large-scale challenges in human health and sustainability, from developing better energy systems to designing technologies that improve our ability to understand and treat disease.


My love for mechanical engineering started with Lego and origami, grew through robotics in high school, and eventually became a passion for using those skills to build solutions to real-world problems. Since then, I've developed technical and communication skills across the board that I now hope to use in the energy or biomedical industry.

// SELECTED WORK

Cat Tower

PERSONAL PROJECT

SolidWorks

Fabrication

Project Planning

Problem: Build a sturdier, taller, aesthetically pleasing cat tower from scratch.

Design: SolidWorks

The tower needed to be over 6 feet tall without becoming unstable, while not visually taking up too much space and fitting in with the room's furniture. I used 2 angled structural members that kept the center of mass close to the wall.

Fabrication

I priced out the wood, fasteners, and tools and methodically scheduled a building period of less than 2 weeks.

Result

Our two cats love scrambling across the tower and it has remained stable. Importantly, this gave me a chance to take a project from an idea and CAD model through material procurement and into assembly.
